moments.author: New Orleans Saints Defensive Coordinator Brandon Staley (via ESPN & NBC Sports)
moments.quote: The team and Justin Reid are working through some things after he requested his release; expect a resolution soon.
moments.why: Men 25–45 are buzzing on NFL boards as a veteran Super Bowl–winning safety requests release mid‑season.

moments.author: Jordan Schultz
moments.quote: The Saints are planning to grant Justin Reid’s release request—both sides agreed it's mutually beneficial; he’s expected to land with a contender.
moments.why: A high‑profile mid‑season release news that’s dominating sports X‑feeds and fantasy talk.

moments.author: Intuit (via Reuters)
moments.quote: Intuit agrees to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.68 billion—$3.31 billion cash, $368 million in stock.
moments.why: Big business move and sharp markdown from its 2021 valuation, sparking finance and tech chatter.

moments.author: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei (via TechTwitter)
moments.quote: My co‑founders and I started Anthropic because we believe that… shared their remarks on our initial IPO mission.
moments.why: Tech investors and AI‑obsessives are tuning into a major IPO reveal straight from the CEO.

moments.author: Tech user @thsottiaux (via TechTwitter)
moments.quote: We’re starting to test dots with a small number of ChatGPT Plus users… and working on a new mobile experience!
moments.why: AI/product developers are geeking out over new ChatGPT features rolling out.
